The paper builds a knowledge-graph-enhanced QA system. An LLM planner issues graph queries, and the answers are grounded in the retrieved evidence. This fits the registered definition of RAG, which includes knowledge-graph retrieval as long as the retrieved text goes to the generator. The abstract also reports experiments that compare the system against a standard RAG baseline and graph-based baselines. It is not multimodal and not a survey, so it should be included.
